name: See How the Cat Jumps
source:
Living in the west can be dangerous. There's sickness, wild animals, and bandits terrorizing everyone they see. But there’s no need to worry. Not when you have the town’s gentleman cowboy at your side to protect you. 

[From [url=https://thechosengiraffe.itch.io/see-how-the-cat-jumps]itch.io[/url]]
